executive_summary: Create a flagship identity that feels like a morning ritual made physical: warm, tactile, optimistic, and unmistakably Morrow. The engagement connects brand story, spatial moments, launch content, and staff experience into one coherent opening.
goals: Turn the new location into a recognizable neighborhood destination.
Build a launch system that works across space, social, print, and events.
Give the team a practical toolkit they can use after opening week.
scope: Flagship creative direction and visual story.
Environmental moments, menu language, and wayfinding concepts.
Launch campaign, opening-week programming, and content toolkit.
Staff story guide and customer-experience principles.

milestones.title: Find the spark
milestones.description: Immersion, audience interviews, references, and creative territories.

milestones.title: Build the world
milestones.description: Identity system, spatial applications, campaign concept, and prototypes.

milestones.title: Make it real
milestones.description: Production files, launch assets, staff toolkit, and opening support.

deliverables: Launch campaign system and content plan
assumptions: Client feedback is consolidated within two business days.
Fabrication and media costs are scoped separately.
